description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Load a public URL in headless Chromium and return Markdown, plain text, or HTML (`format`, plus status_code, title, billed; optional links via `advanced.include_links`). `mode` sets latency and depth: fast (15 s, minimal render), render (30 s, default, full JS), full (60 s, scroll the page). Put scroll, wait_for, js_code, headers, cookies, and auth in `advanced` (`options` is deprecated, same shape). Prefer readfetch_text when JavaScript is not required; readfetch_fetch for raw HTTP/API bytes; readfetch_residential when the site blocks datacentre IPs; readfetch_screenshot for a PNG/JPEG. Bot-check or empty extractions may return `billed: false` with a hint.

cookies.title: Cookies

token.description: Bearer token when `type` is bearer (Authorization: Bearer …).
token.title: Token

Auth.title: Auth

url.description: Optional full URL scope for the cookie; alternative to `domain`/`path`.
url.title: Url

cookies.description: Inject cookies without `auth`; same shape as auth cookies.
cookies.title: Cookies

delay_before_return_ms.description: Pause after navigation before snapshot (0–60000, default 0); use for short post-load animations.
delay_before_return_ms.title: Delay Before Return Ms

headers.description: Extra HTTP request headers for the navigation (merged with defaults).
headers.title: Headers

include_html.description: When true, include raw HTML in the response in addition to the primary `format` field.
include_html.title: Include Html

include_links.description: When true, add a `links` array (href/text) alongside the main body.
include_links.title: Include Links

js_code.description: JavaScript executed in the page before extraction; one string or an array run in order. Disables shared-browser cache for this call.
js_code.title: Js Code

locale.description: Browser locale, e.g. 'en-US'. Sets Accept-Language inside the render.
locale.title: Locale

max_scroll_steps.description: Cap scroll iterations when `scan_full_page` is true (1–200); omit for engine default.
max_scroll_steps.title: Max Scroll Steps

scan_full_page.description: Scroll the page to trigger lazy-loaded content; combine with `mode=full` or `max_scroll_steps`.
scan_full_page.title: Scan Full Page

sticky_session.description: Pin one outbound address for the whole call instead of one per connection. A render already runs under one egress session, so the page load never spreads across exits; accepted for compatibility with callers that set it.
sticky_session.title: Sticky Session

user_agent.description: Override the default browser User-Agent for this render only.
user_agent.title: User Agent

wait_for.description: CSS selector that must appear before capture; pairs with `wait_for_timeout_ms`.
wait_for.title: Wait For

wait_for_timeout_ms.description: Max milliseconds to wait for `wait_for` (0–120000, default 10000).
wait_for_timeout_ms.title: Wait For Timeout Ms

advanced.description: Browser interactions: scroll, wait_for selector, js_code, headers, cookies, locale, include_links, etc.

auth.description: Optional cookie, bearer, or basic auth for the page load.

format.description: Primary body field returned: markdown (default), plain text, or raw HTML.
format.title: Format

mode.description: Whole-call budget and render depth: fast (15 s), render (30 s, default), or full (60 s with page scroll).
mode.title: Mode

options.description: Deprecated — use `advanced` instead (same ScrapeOptions shape). Scheduled for removal in a future API semver bump.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to load in Chromium.
url.title: Url
